create_numpy_resize: create a NumpyResize transform to resize a numpy array image to a given size using bilinear interpolation
create_numpy_flip: create a NumpyFlip transform to randomly flip a numpy array image horizontally with configurable probability
create_numpy_to_tensor: create a NumpyToTensor transform to convert a numpy array image into a PyTorch tensor
load_image_with_pil_loader: load an image from a file path as a PIL RGB image or numpy array using pil_loader
build_standard_transform: build a standard image transform pipeline with resize, tensor conversion, and normalization using standardTransform
